description: Stock Connect (沪深港通) daily channel statistics: GROSS TURNOVER for Northbound (mainland A-shares bought via Hong Kong -- 沪股通/深股通/combined) and Southbound (Hong Kong-listed stocks bought by mainland investors -- 港股通沪/港股通深/combined), plus a best-effort per-stock "top traded stocks" list for Northbound. Answers "northbound stock connect turnover today", "沪深股通成交额", "how much did northbound/southbound trade today", "stock connect top traded stocks". IMPORTANT: mainland regulators (CSRC) stopped publishing DAILY net fund-flow figures (net buy/sell, daily inflow, remaining quota) for NORTHBOUND Stock Connect in August 2024 -- every Northbound channel's net_flow field says so explicitly rather than returning null as if it were real data; gross turnover is unaffected and is published daily for every channel. Southbound net flow is still disclosed by Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing and is returned when available. A turnover-ranked top-10-stocks list for Northbound depends on an Eastmoney report that has returned a server error on every live probe during this build -- the tool still attempts it live on every call and reports plainly under top_traded_stocks.northbound whether real data came back, rather than silently omitting the field or faking rows. Source: Shanghai Stock Exchange / Shenzhen Stock Exchange / Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, via Eastmoney datacenter (keyless).

date.description: Trading day as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD (default: most recent day with published data -- today's session often has not published yet).
